summary: Successfully executed the full live end-to-end Production Confirmation (Test) flow for product 100162723-5 on model 100162723-5_2 (multi-operation) and captured ALL 9 required screenshots at /app/test_reports/wi_screenshots/. Real SAP Production Order 73309 was created (proposal 232834), released, and both reporting points (RP_10 OP_10 - BLANK+PUNCHING intermediate, and END OP_20 - BENDING final) were confirmed for qty=5, with the END step marked Finished. Task completed as intended (real data left in SAP per user approval).

wi_capture_results.note_on_step5: The polling loop against the Production Confirmation tab's default Open (Released/Started) list did NOT surface lot 73309 within the 5-minute window - open-lots came back with 519 rows but none matched production_order_id=73309 even ~9 minutes after release. However the lot WAS created in SAP: /api/production-confirmation/lot/73309 returned it immediately with both RP_10 and END reporting points populated. Using the UI's Manual Lot ID lookup ('73309' -> Look Up) directly retrieved and displayed both rows, unblocking steps 6-10. This appears to be a lag in the open-lots query (probably an SAP Query Production Lots OData index update delay) rather than a hard bug, but is worth calling out as a subtle UX gap since the auto-refresh path is the primary flow documented for staff. Consider auto-falling back to a direct lot lookup by production_order_id when a just-released proposal doesn't show up in open-lots within N seconds, or at least surfacing a hint 'not seeing your lot? try Manual Lot ID lookup with the Production Order ID from history'.

critical_code_review_comments: Production Confirmation open-lots endpoint has a measurable freshness lag (>9 min in this run) versus the direct /production-confirmation/lot/{id} endpoint which returned the just-created lot immediately. If staff following this WI hit the same lag, they'll assume the automation failed. Suggest either (a) after successful proposal release, automatically issue a targeted direct-lookup by production_order_id and merge it into the visible list, or (b) add an explicit banner on the Production Confirmation tab telling the user how long open-lots typically takes to refresh + prompting them to use Manual Lot ID lookup with the Production Order ID from the create-order history.

ConfirmDialog's submit button correctly gates on stock check completion ('Checking stock...' -> 'Post Confirmation'), but there is no visible progress/timer for the stock-check phase itself (only for the post-submit SAP phase). A user watching the dialog might click Cancel prematurely on a slow stock check.

Pre-existing note (unchanged): ProductionConfirmationTestPage.js is 2534 lines and mixes CreateOrderTab, ConfirmDialog, ManageReasonsDialog, and the main table into one file - due for a split for readability/testability.

The one live-flow snag encountered: /api/production-confirmation/open-lots?status=open had a >9 min lag surfacing our just-released lot even though /api/production-confirmation/lot/{id} returned it immediately - working around via the UI's Manual Lot ID input was the reliable path.
rca of the issue: Not a bug run. One observed friction point (documented in critical_code_review_comments): open-lots freshness lag vs direct lot lookup. Root cause is almost certainly the SAP Query Production Lots OData index / caching layer being slower than the SOAP-based single-lot query used by the manual lookup path. Mitigation: post-release, augment the Active Orders card with a 'Track in Production Confirmation' link that pre-fills the Manual Lot ID input with the production_order_id so users don't have to wait on the list refresh.
